title: We were being watched
pt: Foco da aula: passivo contínuo no passado: privacidade e vigilância

solo90.name: Pausa
solo90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

group90.name: Pausa
group90.desc: 5 minutos: câmera e microfone desligados. O professor anota 3 erros reais ouvidos até aqui para a correção final.

lines.en: Freya, did you read the report? Last year our emails were being monitored, and nobody told us.
lines.pt: Freya, você leu o relatório? No ano passado nossos e-mails estavam sendo monitorados, e ninguém nos avisou.

lines.en: Yes, I did. While we were being watched, the company was being advised by a security firm.
lines.pt: Li, sim. Enquanto éramos vigiados, a empresa estava sendo orientada por uma empresa de segurança.

lines.en: I always felt something was wrong. When I walked past the manager’s door, my screen was being checked.
lines.pt: Eu sempre senti que algo estava errado. Quando eu passava pela porta do gerente, minha tela estava sendo verificada.

lines.en: Worse than that, our locations were being tracked by the company phones. That is a serious breach of privacy.
lines.pt: Pior que isso, nossa localização estava sendo rastreada pelos celulares da empresa. É uma grave violação de privacidade.

lines.en: Exactly. Employees should give consent. At that time, nobody was being asked, and nothing was being explained.
lines.pt: Exatamente. Os funcionários deveriam dar consentimento. Na época, ninguém era consultado, e nada era explicado.

lines.en: To be fair, the system was being tested for security reasons. Confidential data was being stolen from other firms.
lines.pt: Para ser justo, o sistema estava sendo testado por motivos de segurança. Dados confidenciais estavam sendo roubados de outras empresas.

lines.en: Maybe, but I was being treated like a suspect. Even my lunch breaks were being timed!
lines.pt: Talvez, mas eu estava sendo tratada como suspeita. Até meus intervalos de almoço estavam sendo cronometrados!

lines.en: Fair point. At the meeting yesterday, the new rules were being discussed, and the staff were being listened to for once.
lines.pt: Justo. Na reunião de ontem, as novas regras estavam sendo discutidas, e os funcionários estavam sendo ouvidos pela primeira vez.

lines.en: Good. While the contract was being changed, I asked about camera footage. It is deleted after a month now.
lines.pt: Bom. Enquanto o contrato estava sendo alterado, perguntei sobre as imagens das câmeras. Agora são apagadas depois de um mês.

lines.en: That is a relief. I could not work properly when I felt that I was being spied on.
lines.pt: Que alívio. Eu não conseguia trabalhar direito quando sentia que estava sendo espionado.

lines.en: Me neither. Now at least we know our rights, and nobody is being watched in secret.
lines.pt: Nem eu. Agora ao menos conhecemos nossos direitos, e ninguém está sendo vigiado em segredo.

facts.label: Passivo contínuo
facts.sub: Ação em andamento no passado: We were being watched. Singular: was being. Plural: were being. Pergunta: Was it being tested?

facts.label: Estava sendo
facts.sub: Passivo contínuo no passado: My screen was being checked. Use was com singular e were com plural. Mostra uma ação em andamento num momento do passado.

facts.label: Cuidado
facts.sub: Depois de was/were, o certo é being, não been: We were being watched. Been aparece no present perfect: We have been watched. Troque pela forma certa.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The past continuous passive is was/were being + participle.
We say “The phones were been tracked”.
It describes actions in progress in the past.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The past continuous passive is was/were being + participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The phones were been tracked”. → Falso (We say were being tracked.)
It describes actions in progress in the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Who was watching us? · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in an office in Brisbane. Pam arrives early with a report in her hand. Her colleague Noah is already at his desk. The report is about surveillance at work. It describes what happened last year. Both of them have strong opinions.

“Noah, did you read the report? Last year our emails were being monitored, and nobody told us.” says Pam. “Yes, I did. While we were being watched, the company was being advised by a security firm.” says Noah. “I always felt something was wrong. When I walked past the manager’s door, my screen was being checked.” says Pam.
